title: every not-PROVED ticket's plan migrates to outcomes, its trail and by-lines moved whole to its log
intention: Every ticket that is not PROVED carries its plan as outcomes: the falsifier's clauses as outcomes 1..k with their claims, each remaining decision as an outcome numbered after them carrying its text and no claim (awaiting judgement at build-open), its trail moved whole to its log and its by-lines gone. Nothing is judged in bulk.
why: Akien, 2026-11-14, on d421051bc1f7: "a ticket shouldn't look like that. it's 3 parts, a metadata and a build plan. this kind of stuff is all supposed to be history. and all tickets were supposed to migrate to that format." Measured the same day: 79 of 276 open tickets fail transitions._shape_lacks, and 62 carry 165 trail-like decision lines.
traces_to: Law 5: the address carries what a mind needs now. Outline 3.3.2: the plan holds only what a builder builds from, and the history is the log.
how: One migration module in the rehearsal machine, beside retire: the mechanical step of outline 9.3.5.1.2.1. It invents no claim, no dependency, no via, no constraint and no resource. rehearsal's own readers accept both shapes through base's plan view (sibling 5c1e0a7d93b2). retire's author tooth goes, per Q#96. d421051bc1f7 is the hand-built worked example. The live run is one command after PROVED, after 5c1e0a7d93b2 lands (the cast door must read `outcomes`).

clauses.claim: after the run, no open ticket in a scratch commons carries `decisions`, and none whose falsifier had numbered clauses carries `falsifier`; each carries `outcomes`: clause n is outcome n {n, claim, writes_to: [], reads: [], after: []}, and the i-th remaining decision in list order is outcome k+i {n, text (its leading 'D<n>: ' dropped), writes_to, reads, after: []} with no claim
no outcome's text opens with a fold, MEASURED, SETTLES, re-point or superseded marker, and no outcome carries `by`
every moved trail line and every dropped `by` stands verbatim in its ticket's log, read back through ticket_log.read_log
every PROVED ticket's plan, state and log files are byte-identical before and after the run
a second run moves nothing and writes nothing
retire accepts a line whose `by` differs from the retirer's, so the 'not yours to retire' lack is gone
the migration invents nothing: no decision-made outcome has a claim, no outcome has a non-empty after or a via, no ticket gains constraints or resources, and bounds and measured are byte-identical

the report names, per open ticket, the n of each outcome awaiting judgement, too_big when it holds more than 7 outcomes, and a prose (unnumbered) falsifier, which stays as written; a coherent fixture is named for none
rehearsal's labeled, decide and scope read a migrated ticket's steps as they read the same ticket before migration (same n, same text, same paths)

decisions.text: D1: plan_migration.migrate(root) walks <root>/tickets, skips any ticket whose state or plan workflow_and_state carries [PROVED], and writes each changed plan through rehearsal._write_ticket, never write_text.

D2: a trail line is a decision whose text, case-folded, opens with a fold marker, MEASURED, SETTLES, re-point or superseded. Each moves whole to the log as kind decision_retired via ticket_log.append_log, and leaves the plan.
D3: each remaining decision's `by` is logged (kind field, body {n, by}) and removed.

D4: the plan becomes outcomes: numbered falsifier clauses first, each {n, claim, writes_to: [], reads: [], after: []} with n kept; then each remaining decision in list order as {n: k+i, text (leading 'D<n>: ' dropped), writes_to, reads, after: []}, no claim. The `decisions` key goes, and `falsifier` goes when its clauses moved. A prose falsifier stays as written and the report names it.

D5: migrate returns {ticket_id: report} for every open ticket: awaiting (the n of each outcome with no claim), too_big when outcomes > 7 (the outline's ~7), prose_falsifier, and transitions._shape_lacks over the result. It judges nothing and moves nothing on a finding; the judgement step is at build-open.
D6: rehearsal's step readers (labeled, decide, retire, scope) read through base's plan view (sibling 5c1e0a7d93b2), so an outcomes plan and a decisions plan rehearse alike; after: 5c1e0a7d93b2.
D7: _retire_lacks loses its author check, per outline 9.3.5.1.1 (Q#96), and the rehearsal charter's public_interface names migrate.

D8: the proof copies a fixture commons (open with numbered clauses, open trail-bearing with by-lines, open prose-falsifier, open too-big, open coherent, and PROVED tickets) into a scratch root, runs migrate twice, and has one tooth per clause.

out: the cast door, the plan view and ticket_log's rejoin (sibling 5c1e0a7d93b2)
every other reader component (its own sibling ticket)
the judgement step at build-open (sibling 4d8a2c6e91f7, skills/sail: each awaiting outcome gets a claim or moves to constraints)
the live run over the real commons, which goes after PROVED and after 5c1e0a7d93b2

measured.saw: 276 open tickets, 771 PROVED; 79 open fail _shape_lacks; 62 open carry 165 trail-like decision lines; d421051bc1f7 alone has 65 lacks
measured.how: a scratch script over origin/main's CairnCommons/tickets calling transitions._shape_lacks with the store charter, and a marker regex over decision text

measured.saw: Akien answered Q#100 (open-7c607df497bd, open-91e33982f3d5), then the same day (open-7aee6f89e4d9, open-82f27105184f): "rather than tasks should we be focused on outcomes?" ... "an outcome can hide the how, and i try and specify the how when i'm attached to it ... yes, we're in agreement. signed -amm". Outline 9.3.5.1.2.1: the migration is mechanical now and judgement at build-open, never in bulk; this ticket is the mechanical step.
measured.how: his answer, relayed verbatim by orchestrator; recorded at the question door; outline 9.3.5.1.2.1
